claims.claim_text: Engineering executive who connects regulated modernization, governed agentic AI architecture, and IP-led growth through one disciplined platform operating model.
That leadership foundation embeds release automation and security scanning into regulated modernization delivery paths, making release resilience part of the operating model.
From that operating base, SVP Engineering control-plane architecture gives agentic AI a governed platform shape for scalable technical decision-making.
Against that platform lineage, human override, escalation paths, and replayable proof bundles reinforce traceable execution and accountable operating decisions.
In parallel, platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and team scale, tying architecture choices to measurable business value.
Future platform leadership can keep governed execution, productization, and regulated modernization aligned as the platform matures.
